Amy — great questions and thanks for sending the PRD. Quick recap and proposed next actions so we’re aligned: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Key metrics: hallucination rate per prompt, token-level cost, 95th/99th latency for short and long completions, and quantization impact.
- Security is a gating concern (PII). You need SOC2 evidence and sample audit logs.

Our proposed test matrix (attached):
1) Baseline: Redwood hosted API vs your hyperscaler endpoint (same model family where possible) — run the FinTech PRD prompt set; measure per-prompt hallucination rate and token cost.
2) Private run: Redwood Private (VPC) using a closed deployment with same prompts; capture audit logs and retention settings.
3) Regression probes: a focused hallucination probe suite (~120 prompts) + 30 red-team prompts you provide.
4) Latency microbench: Batching off vs batching on; 1, 8, 32 concurrency for short (<=128) and long (>=1024) sequences.

Next steps I propose:
- We run step (1) this week and share a snapshot report.
- Schedule a 30-min working session (30–45 min) next Tue/Wed to align the regression probes and security checklist.
- I’ll loop in our SOC2 point of contact for the audit artifacts.

I attached a proposed-test-matrix.xlsx with the first-pass telemetry fields. If you can share a small sample of the red-team prompts (or we can use our standard hallucination set) we’ll include them in the run.

Adding a few technical clarifications from the ops side so FinTechCorp and our team have the same expectations: 

- Model variants: we'll run the same nominal model (e.g., open-family-70B equivalent). For quantization comparison we will run fp16 (baseline) and int8/awq where feasible. We’ll flag variant-specific differences in the report.
- Hallucination metric: we’ll compute a binary hallucination flag per prompt (human-labeled) and a normalized hallucination score per 1k tokens for long-form outputs.
- Token cost: we’ll report token charges as if run on typical hosted pricing and show an estimated unit cost for private deployment (in terms of GPU-hours).
- Audit logs: Soojin will attach an example abbreviated audit log extract showing request-id, requester, model_version, timestamps, and retention TTL.
